title: Portfolio Platform
tagline: This website: a Next.js 3D frontend with an event-driven Go backend
description: A Next.js and React Three Fiber frontend backed by a Go API. Contact messages are stored in PostgreSQL and published to RabbitMQ. A worker sends the emails, with timed retry queues, a dead-letter queue for bad messages and a parking-lot queue for messages that keep failing.
highlights: RabbitMQ topology: retry queues at 5s / 30s / 2m, a DLQ and a parking lot
Publisher confirms and manual acks, so no message is silently lost
Per-IP token-bucket rate limiting, honeypot spam filter, panic-safe goroutines
Runs with zero infra in memory mode; one docker compose up for the full stack

title: Expense Tracker
tagline: Full-stack finance tracker with stateless JWT security
description: Users register, log in and track their expenses. A custom Spring Security filter validates JWTs on every request, passwords are BCrypt-hashed, and admin-only routes are protected by role.
highlights: Astro + React frontend with Formik and Yup validation

title: Real-time Chat
description: Create or join a room and chat live. Spring Boot runs a STOMP message broker over WebSocket, rooms and messages are stored in MongoDB, and the React client gets updates instantly.
highlights: STOMP over SockJS with a Spring message broker
Custom error codes and a global exception handler
OpenAPI / Swagger docs for the REST endpoints

title: E-Commerce Storefront
description: A storefront with hero banners, a product grid, testimonials and a newsletter footer. It uses a shared layout with nested routes in React Router 7, styled with Tailwind CSS 4.
highlights: Mobile-first layout across sm / md / lg breakpoints
Shared layout with nested routes and an Outlet

title: React Components Lab
description: Accordion, image slider, tree view, QR generator, star rating, load-more pagination, a random color generator, a scroll indicator, and dark mode with a custom useLocalStorage hook.
highlights: Custom hook that persists the theme
API pagination with loading and error states

title: Smart Vendor
description: Admin, Vendor and User portals with role-based access control and tenant data isolation. Inventory, order processing and vendor analytics modules are being built.
